# podcast_scraper

> Close Listening's public core: the ingestion pipeline (RSS, transcription, diarization, cleaning, summaries, grounded insights, knowledge graph), the corpus and its migrations, search, the API that serves the corpus and the app state, and the gi-kg-viewer. Private extensions (Common) add stages and commands through the seams.

Rules for coding agents are in AGENTS.md, linked below section by section; CLAUDE.md adds Claude Code specifics. Docs are an MkDocs site under docs/: ADRs, RFCs and PRDs each have an index (linked under Decisions and specs), guides are listed in full, architecture docs describe the system as built, docs/wip holds plans and the corpus change records.

Every change to what the corpus serves starts with its change record (docs/guides/CORPUS_CHANGE_METHOD.md). Prod and deployment runbooks are operator documentation, not in this repository.

This file is generated by scripts/llms_txt.py from llms.config.json; `make llms-txt` rewrites it and `make llms-txt-check` fails when it is stale or a link does not resolve.

## Agent rules (AGENTS.md)

- [Deployment topology — GROUND TRUTH, never re-derived from config files](AGENTS.md#deployment-topology--ground-truth-never-re-derived-from-config-files): LLM path (prod): app -> LiteLLM gateway on the prod VPS -> OpenRouter -> vendor
- [WHERE TO LOOK — load these BEFORE answering, do not re-derive](AGENTS.md#where-to-look--load-these-before-answering-do-not-re-derive): When a question lands in one of these areas, read the listed files first.
- [RULES YOU KEEP BREAKING](AGENTS.md#rules-you-keep-breaking-read-every-session): Not aspirational.

- [Autonomous execution](AGENTS.md#autonomous-execution): When intent is clear, do the work in-session: run Makefile targets, scripts,
- [Running a multi-step arc](AGENTS.md#running-a-multi-step-arc): How the operator wants a long piece of work run (a branch with several plan items, a naming or migration arc).
- [Stack](AGENTS.md#stack): Python 3.12 (`.python-version`; the images run `python:3.12`), Pydantic v2, pytest, black/isort/flake8/mypy, MkDocs
- [Project context](AGENTS.md#project-context)
- [Git workflow](AGENTS.md#git-workflow)
- [Tool usage](AGENTS.md#tool-usage)
- [Code quality and testing](AGENTS.md#code-quality-and-testing)
- [CodeQL alert dismissals](AGENTS.md#codeql-alert-dismissals): Trigger: CodeQL fails on a PR.
- [GitHub](AGENTS.md#github): Use MCP GitHub server tools when available; fall back to `gh` CLI if MCP
- [Essential commands](AGENTS.md#essential-commands)
- [Detail file references](AGENTS.md#detail-file-references)
- [Documentation prose](AGENTS.md#documentation-prose): In `docs/` (PRD/RFC/ADR/guides/api/wip), `AGENTS.md`, `.cursorrules`, `CLAUDE.md`, `.ai-coding-guidelines.md`, and …

- [rss/](docs/guides/RSS_GUIDE.md): This guide describes how RSS (and Atom-style) podcast feeds are fetched, cached, parsed, and turned into `Episode` …
- [translation/, languages](docs/guides/LANGUAGE_ONBOARDING_RUNBOOK.md): adding a language; also [the multilingual arc](docs/architecture/MULTILINGUAL_ARC_V2.md)
- [extensions, seams](docs/guides/PROTOCOL_EXTENSION_GUIDE.md): what an installed extension can add
- [web/workbench/](docs/architecture/VIEWER_FRONTEND_ARCHITECTURE.md): the viewer's frontend; also [the graph spec](docs/architecture/VIEWER_GRAPH_SPEC.md)
- [tests/](docs/guides/TESTING_GUIDE.md): which tests to run and write; also [unit](docs/guides/UNIT_TESTING_GUIDE.md), [integration](docs/guides/INTEGRATION_TESTING_GUIDE.md), [e2e](docs/guides/E2E_TESTING_GUIDE.md)

## By service (GlitchTip and the homelab stack)

- [podcast-pipeline](docs/guides/PIPELINE_AND_WORKFLOW.md): the pipeline CLI and its jobs; GlitchTip `podcast-pipeline` (dev: `podcast-pipeline-dev`); OTel service `podcast-pipeline`; compose service `pipeline`
- [podcast-api](docs/guides/SERVER_GUIDE.md): the API in the operator plane; GlitchTip `podcast-api` (dev: `podcast-api-dev`); OTel service `podcast-api`; compose service `api`
- [player-api](docs/architecture/DATABASE.md): the same API in the player plane; GlitchTip `player-api`; OTel service `player-api`
- [workbench](docs/architecture/VIEWER_FRONTEND_ARCHITECTURE.md): Workbench, the operator viewer (browser); GlitchTip `gi-kg-viewer` (no dev project yet); compose service `workbench`
- [player, player-mcp, player-obs](docs/guides/LIVE_PIPELINE_MONITOR.md): the player web app and the MCP servers report to these GlitchTip projects from repos other than this one; the observability control plane's core is src/podcast_obs
